g.text: Fig. 3 — The three state machines a department runs on

text.style: font-size: 5.9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Only the desk (ADMIN or HOD) may move the middle and lower lanes. Rails sit above a lane so several transitions can leave one state; the right column holds the rules that have no state of their own.
